name: Match arms select by guard, pattern alternative, and a final else fallback

independent_sources: module M { public fun run() -> Object { match 5 { x if x > 3 => :big, _ => :small } } } M.run()
module M { public fun run() -> Object { match 2 { 1 | 2 => :low, _ => :other } } } M.run()
module M { public fun run() -> Object { match 9 { 1 => :one, else => :fell } } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Match arm selection has no native boundary.
